newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices mixed in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices mixed in thin trade.

text.p: Gold prices ended mixed on Istanbul's gold exchange on Thursday amid falling demand from the free market, brokers said.
Gold closed at $379.70 an ounce, down from a $380.40 Wednesday close, but in lira terms it firmed to 1,129,750 lira from yesterday's 1,129,500 due to currency weaknes.
The lira closed weaker at 92,415 to the dollar, from a 92,075 Wednesday close.
Dealers said demand had faded in the recent days and volume fell to 202 kilos from 310 kilos.
"Volume narrowed again amid a lack of demand from the free market and central Anatolian traders," said a gold broker.
The weakness of prices in dollar terms reflected the pattern on the world market.
